## Documentation

Listed in reading order, grouped as on the site.

### Start here
- [Getting started](https://straion.com/docs/getting-started): A step by step guide to set up Straion: import your rules, install the CLI, and connect your first AI coding agent in under five minutes.
- [Prerequisites](https://straion.com/docs/prerequisites): What you need before you start using Straion: a workspace, a supported AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot), and access to your team's rules.
- [Core concepts](https://straion.com/docs/core-concepts): What rules are and how Straion uses them to keep AI coding agents aligned with your standards

### Rules
- [Import rules](https://straion.com/docs/import-rules): How Straion turns your existing standards and repository instruction files into structured, validated rule collections
- [Connect a repository](https://straion.com/docs/connect-repository): Store your rules as code in your own git repository and keep them in sync with Straion.
- [Rule file format](https://straion.com/docs/rule-file-format): The on-disk layout and file format for rules stored in a connected git repository.
- [Best practices](https://straion.com/docs/best-practices): How to write clear, well-formed rules that AI coding agents can interpret correctly

### Using Straion
- [Developing with rules](https://straion.com/docs/develop-with-rules): Use the developing-with-rules workflow to have Straion select relevant rules, validate your plan, generate constrained code, and check the output before you commit.
- [Validate specs](https://straion.com/docs/validate-specs): Check specs, RFCs, and design docs against your rules before implementation begins
- [Validate implementation plans](https://straion.com/docs/validate-implementation-plan): Catch rule violations in an implementation plan before any code is written
- [Validate code](https://straion.com/docs/validate-code): Validate a PR, diff, or AI-generated changes against your rules before merge

### Organization & Account
- [Invite Users](https://straion.com/docs/invite-users): How to invite team members to your Straion organization: add email addresses, manage pending invites, and assign member roles.
- [SAML Single Sign-On (SSO)](https://straion.com/docs/sso): Connect Straion to your identity provider with SAML SSO: step-by-step setup guides for Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, OneLogin, and any SAML 2.0 provider.
- [SCIM provisioning](https://straion.com/docs/scim): Automatically create, update, and deactivate Straion users from your identity provider with SCIM 2.0: setup guides for Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, OneLogin, and other providers.

### References
- [CLI reference](https://straion.com/docs/cli-api-reference): Reference for every Straion CLI command: login, logout, setup, and import-rules, with the options and flags each command accepts.
- [Troubleshooting](https://straion.com/docs/troubleshooting): Solutions to common Straion issues: agent setup checks, firewall and permission problems, skills that do not show up after setup, and SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning errors.

### Not in the sidebar
- [Example prompts](https://straion.com/docs/example-prompts): Copy-paste prompts for common Straion workflows: build a feature end-to-end, plan an implementation, validate a spec, and validate code.

## Blog
- [The Straion Blog](https://straion.com/blog): Insights on AI-assisted development, coding standards at scale, and building software that stays on track. Lessons, deep dives, and perspectives.
- [1M Tokens Won't Save Your Engineering Standards](https://straion.com/blog/1m-tokens-wont-save-your-engineering-standards): Sourcegraph data from 1,281 agent runs confirms the research: more context degrades AI coding performance. Why less context wins, and what it means for tools.
- [90% Rule Adherence](https://straion.com/blog/90-percent-rule-adherence-straion-coding-agents): When Claude Code runs with Straion, rule adherence climbs into the 90%+ range. See how the automated context layer keeps AI code on your standards.
- [The Real Cost of Building AI Coding Governance](https://straion.com/blog/build-vs-buy-ai-coding-governance): Building your own AI coding governance layer sounds like a config project. It isn't. Here is what it actually takes, and when buying is the smarter call.
- [Your AGENTS.md is costing more than you think](https://straion.com/blog/delete-your-claude-md-science-says-so): ETH Zurich research: LLM-generated AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files cut resolve rates and raise cost. The fix is delivering only the rules that matter, per task.
- [Developers Asked Anthropic to Build This. We Did.](https://straion.com/blog/developers-asked-anthropic-to-build-this): A developer filed GitHub issue #14467 on claude-code describing exactly the problem Straion solves. We built it. Here is the full story.
- [You Shouldn't Be Finding Rule Violations in Code Review](https://straion.com/blog/rule-violations-code-review): Straion turns every rule that applies to a change into a decision the agent has to resolve before the work is done, and every exception into one you approve.
- [Straion Rules Now Live in Git](https://straion.com/blog/straion-rules-now-live-in-git): Straion rules can now be managed in Git: versioning, pull request reviews, and full history. Available on the enterprise plan and in the free trial.
- [We raised €1.1M to fix AI coding drift](https://straion.com/blog/we-raised-1-1m-to-fix-ai-coding-drift): Straion announces its €1.1M seed round led by Marathon VC and outlines why autonomous engineering needs a rules layer to prevent AI coding drift.

## Product
- [The governancelayer for AI coding.](https://straion.com/product): Straion is the governance layer for AI coding. It keeps Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot aligned with your rules and standards, from first prompt to merge.
- [AI Coding Agent Guidance with Company Standards | Straion](https://straion.com/product/ai-coding-guidance): Guide Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot with company-specific rules so AI-generated code follows your architecture, security, and quality standards.
- [AI-Powered Code Review](https://straion.com/product/code-review): Automate pull request validation against non-functional requirements. Straion reduces manual review time and keeps code aligned with company standards.
- [Transform vague ideas into actionable requirements](https://straion.com/product/feedback-on-requirements): Capture and manage your organization's requirements, and ensure your software specifications and code stay aligned every step of the way.
- ["We already use AGENTS.md.Why do we need Straion?"](https://straion.com/product/straion-vs-agents-md): Already using AGENTS.md across your repos? See what Straion adds: a real before/after import, plus why the file breaks down at team scale.
- ["I already have custom skills.What does Straion add?"](https://straion.com/product/straion-vs-skills): Already using custom skills in Claude Code or Cursor? Here's what Straion adds, and why the maintenance problem only grows at team scale.
